title: fix(openwebui): run production on standard-4
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Production Open WebUI (2,373 users, one instance) is on `standard-1`: 0.5 vCPU, 4 GiB
- It currently doesn't answer: `/health` times out after 60 s while the instance reports `running`
- Moves production to `standard-4` (4 vCPU, 12 GiB, 20 GB), the largest predefined type; staging stays on `standard-1`
- Changing the instance type is a container config change, so the deploy rolls out a fresh instance

| | vCPU | Memory | Disk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before | 0.5 | 4 GiB | 8 GB |
| After | 4 | 12 GiB | 20 GB |

gist.headline: More room for the hive
gist.blurb: Production Open WebUI gets a bigger home. The instance that kept running without answering gets enough room to do both.
gist.summary: Production Open WebUI moves from standard-1 (0.5 vCPU, 4 GiB memory, 8 GB disk) to standard-4 (4 vCPU, 12 GiB memory, 20 GB disk) to address /health requests timing out after 60 seconds; staging stays on standard-1.
gist.impact: The larger production instance gives Open WebUI more headroom to respond to health checks and serve its 2,373 users.
